scripts.predev: docker compose up -d --wait && npm run build --workspace=@workout-logging/shared
scripts.prod:start: aws ec2 start-instances --instance-ids i-0adb320f36e574e38 --region eu-central-1 --output text && aws ec2 wait instance-running --instance-ids i-0adb320f36e574e38 --region eu-central-1 && echo 'running — datastores need ~1-2 min more; check with: npm run prod:health'
scripts.prod:stop: aws ec2 stop-instances --instance-ids i-0adb320f36e574e38 --region eu-central-1 --output text && aws ec2 wait instance-stopped --instance-ids i-0adb320f36e574e38 --region eu-central-1 && echo stopped
scripts.prod:status: aws ec2 describe-instances --instance-ids i-0adb320f36e574e38 --region eu-central-1 --query 'Reservations[0].Instances[0].State.Name' --output text
